headline: Perenti Secures $674 Million Geita Mine Contract as AngloGold Expands in Tanzania
summary: Australian contractor Perenti won a five-year, $674 million underground mining contract at the Geita Gold Mine in Tanzania. Owner AngloGold Ashanti plans up to $580 million in capital expansion to boost production to 600,000 ounces by 2030.
why: AngloGold Ashanti is one of the world's leading gold producers, while Perenti is a major provider of mining services.
